morphology.pattern_note: 直接添加后缀 -an，词根拼写不变；词根末尾的 n 在音节划分中成为末音节的声母：bu.lan → bu.la.nan。

senses.zh_definition: 每月发生、举行、支付、编制或出版的；按月计算的。
senses.en_definition: Occurring, issued, paid, or calculated every month; monthly.
senses.nuances: 表示按月重复的频率或计量周期，不等于“持续一个月”；后者通常用 selama sebulan。一般置于所修饰名词之后；secara bulanan 表示“按月”。月刊也可说 majalah bulanan。[DBP：bulanan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bulanan)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Setiap ketua jabatan diminta mengemukakan laporan bulanan sebelum hari kelima bulan berikutnya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 请各部门主管于次月五日之前提交月度报告。
dual_scenarios.en: Each department head is requested to submit a monthly report before the fifth day of the following month.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Yuran bulanan gim ni berapa, ya?
dual_scenarios.zh: 这家健身房一个月多少钱呀？
dual_scenarios.en: How much is the monthly fee for this gym?
spoken_features: 疑问词 berapa 位于句末
ya 使询问语气更柔和
对话中的 dah、nak、je 分别对应 sudah、hendak、sahaja

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah tanya yuran bulanan gim ni? Aku nak daftar juga.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah bertanya tentang yuran bulanan gim ini? Saya juga hendak mendaftar.
messages.zh: 你问过这家健身房的月费了吗？我也想报名。
messages.en: Have you asked how much this gym charges per month? I'd like to sign up too.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, RM80 je sebulan. Jom daftar sama-sama.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, yurannya hanya RM80 sebulan. Mari kita mendaftar bersama-sama.
messages.zh: 问了，一个月才80令吉。一起报名吧。
messages.en: Yes, it's only RM80 a month. Let's sign up together.

etymology.historical_story: The root bulan names both the moon and a month in Malay, bringing a visible celestial cycle into everyday timekeeping. Bulanan adds a regular monthly relationship to that familiar unit. Salary slips, bank statements, and magazine schedules give learners practical examples of how the same word organizes recurring activities across modern Malaysian life.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bulan＝月亮／月份；加 -an，想到日历每翻一页就重复一次：bulanan＝每月的。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适用于账单、工作汇报和日常消费。询问朋友的个人月薪可能显得冒昧；询问服务月费则很常见。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 商谈租金、订阅或分期付款时，可进一步问 Adakah bayaran ini termasuk semua caj?，确认月费是否包含全部收费。
